m: अप्तूर्य (4) n. zeal, activity, RV. iii, 12, 8 and 51, 9.

s: [s] klI (Apyate svargo laByaMte'nena, Apa + karaRe tasa hrasvaH .) yajYakaBmaH । ityuRAdikozaH ॥

m: अप्तस् n. a sacrificial act, Uṇ.

v: pu॰ aptordehasya yApakatvAdyAma iva alu॰ sa॰ । agnizwomANgayAgaBede “yAvajjIvamagnihotraM juhotIti” SrutyA agnizwomasya dehavyApakakAlakatvAttaTAtvam । “so'ptoryAmeRa yajeta” kAtyA॰ 9, 11, 10, “zaquttare atyagnizwoma ukTyaH zoqaSI vAjapeyo'tirAtro'ptoryAmaH kAtyA॰ 10, 9, 26, ।
m: अप्तोर्-याम, अस् [ŚBr. &c.] or अप्तोर्-यामन्, आ, [PBr.; Lāṭy.] m. a particular way of offering the Soma sacrifice.
a: अप्तोर्यामः, --मन् — m. N. of a sacrifice and of a verse of the Sāma Veda closing that rite; the last or 7th part of the Jyotiṣṭoma sacrifice.

s: puM, (Apyate BogAya prApyate yaH, Ap + karmmaRi tuH hrasvaH .) SarIraM । aNgaM । ityuRAdikozaH ॥ (“aTAptave dvitIye yAmAhutiM juhoti” । iti SatapaTabrAhmaRaH .)
v: na॰ Apyate BIgAya jIvena Apa--tun hrasvaSca । 1 SarIre 2 sUkzmarUpasome ca । “aTAptave dvitIye yAmAhutiM juhoti Sata॰ brA॰ 3, 6, 38, aptuH sUkzmarUpaH somaH BA॰ ।
m: अप्तु mfn. small, tender [Comm.; but perhaps connected with अप्तुर् above, because also, applied to the Soma] MaitrS.; TS.; ŚBr.
a: अप्तु — a. Ved. Busy, active, industrious. --प्तुः (or n. Uṇ. 1. 74) 1 The body. --2 Soma (सूक्ष्मरूपसोम). --3 A sacrificial animal.
अप्तु --प्तूर्यं — [अप्तुरो भावः बाहु ˚वेदे यत्] Sending down water (वृष्टिप्रेरकत्वं), giving of water; zeal (?)

m: अप्तु—मत् mfn. containing the word अप्तु, MaitrS.

v: pu॰ adByaH jaladAnAya tutortti tura--vege kvip । jaladAyake indretasya meGanAyakatvena tatprerakatayA jaladAtftvAttaTAtvam “yajYena gAtumapturo vividrire f॰ 2, 21, 5, “apturaH apAM prerakAdindrAt” BA॰ । 2 taddAyake'nalAdO ca tatrAgnyAdeH “agnO prAstAhutiH samyagAdityamupatizWate AdityAjjAyate vfzwiriti” manUkteH jalaprerakatvam ।
m: अप्तुर् (only acc. sg. and pl. उरम् and उरच्) m. (fr. 1. अप् + √ त्वर्), active, busy (said of the Aśvins, of Soma, of Agni, of Indra), RV.
(accord. to others = अप्-तुर्, ‘vanquishing the waters in speed’, i.e. ‘swift, rapid’).
a: अप्तुर् — m. [अद्भ्यः जलदानाय तुतोर्ति, जलानि प्रेरयति, तुर् क्विप् Tv.] 1 Active, busy, giving water, flowing as water; an epithet of Indra (Sāy. अपां प्रेरक इंद्रः). --2 Fire.

v: na॰ apturo BAvaH bA॰ vede yat । “jalaprerakatve loke tu zyaY Apturyyamityeva । “indrAgnyI! tavizARi vAM saDasTAni payAMsi ca yunorapturyyaM hitam 12, 8, apturyyaM vfzwiprerakatvam BA॰ yuvoryuvayorindrAgnyoH
tri॰ aptuni dehe BavaH yat vede wilopaH । 1 apatye niru॰ 2 dehakarmmaRi sTite ca “pUrvve ardDerajaso aptyasya” f॰ 1, 124, 5 “aptyasya karmaRi sTitasyeti” BA॰
a: अप्त्य — a. [अप्तुनि देहे भवः यत् वेदे टिलोपः Tv.] 1 Engaged in an act, active (देहकर्मणि स्थित). --2 Offspring (अपत्य Nir.)
